product_launches.description: Trade Republic introduced a new trading infrastructure featuring a Mejor Precio algorithm, a Direct Price order type across 30 exchanges, and launched Trading Pro, a free advanced web experience for active investors with real-time data and analytics.

press_references.value: Brad Pitt revoluciona la cuenta remunerada de Trade Republic: sube al 3,04%

product_launches.description: Trade Republic has launched a new version of its remunerated account offering 3.04% APR for new and existing customers in Spain, supported by a major ad campaign fronted by Brad Pitt and including referral-based interest boosts.

press_references.value: Trade Republic with fixed interest and bonds

product_launches.description: Trade Republic launched its second new asset class in Wealth Management: fixed-interest products via bond ETFs, giving European clients flexible access to US government and corporate bonds (e.g., Apple, Netflix) with quarterly interest and yields above the ECB rate.

press_references.value: Trade Republic Launches Its Dutch Banking Offering, Challenging Local Banks With a Free Current Account With a Dutch IBAN and 2% Interest Uncapped on All Cash Deposits

product_launches.description: Trade Republic launched a new Dutch banking offering, including a free current account with a Dutch IBAN and 2% uncapped interest on all cash deposits, challenging local banks in the Netherlands.

press_references.value: Trade Republic Launches Stock Gifting, Ahead of the Christmas Season, to Allow Trade Republic Users to Support Their Family and Friends on Their Savings Journeys

product_launches.description: Trade Republic's new feature allows users to gift stocks and ETFs, supporting long-term savings for recipients.

overview_description.description:
Trade Republic is a mobile-only and commission-free broker that brings the opportunity to invest easily. The company works as a broker for a new generation for a more mobile, more intuitive, faster - and permanently free of commission.

Trade Republic was founded in 2015 and based in Berlin, Germany.
